description: L1 ex_units-sum overflow (consensus split): amaru sums the 3 redeemers declared ex_units with a plain u64 + (ex_units.rs:31, has_ex_units.rs:20-22; release has no overflow-checks); a sum >= 2^64 wraps below the per-tx limit so amaru ACCEPTS. cardano sums as Natural and rejects. NOTE: any amaru-wrapping sum is >= 2^64 > Word64max, so cardano ExUnitsTooBig cannot serialize its provided value (submit connection error) - the same u64/Word64 seam. 3 distinct always-succeeds PlutusV3 mint policies (m1/m2/m3) => 3 Mint redeemers.

cases.note: honest ex_units sum 18e6 mem / 18e9 steps > max (14e6/14e9): both reject ExUnitsTooBigUTxO. Control, no wrap.

ex_units sum = 2^64+~2e6 wraps amaru u64 to ~(2e6 mem, 8e8 steps) < max: amaru ACCEPTS (is_valid, 202); cardano does NOT accept (rejects; its ExUnitsTooBig error carries provided sum > Word64 so it cannot serialize -> submit connection error).
